definitions.gloss: number of deaths; death toll; fatality count
definitions.explanation: How many people died from a given cause or in a given period, as reported in official statistics. Formal register: used in government releases, news reports, and research.

examples.japanese: {死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The number of deaths was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通事故|こうつうじこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of traffic accident deaths is falling year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The number of deaths from infectious disease differs greatly by age.

examples.japanese: {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{公表|こうひょう}している→公表する：21375_kouhyou⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare publishes the number of deaths by cause every year.

notes:
Built from ⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧ (death) plus ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person) plus ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). The suffix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ turns any counted group into its statistic: ⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧ (number of infections), {来場者数|らいじょうしゃすう} (attendance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧／⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: for the death toll to rise / fall
- {死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce the number of deaths
- ⟦{累計|るいけい}→累計：08327_ruikei⟧{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}: cumulative death toll

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{死者数|ししゃすう}→死者数：30171_shishasuu⟧: death toll — shorter and more common in news headlines; the same meaning
- ⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧: victim — emphasizes that the deaths were caused by a disaster or accident
